Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

NURSE-LABS provides public information about the Erasmus+ project, its activities, consortium, results and learning platform access. Personal data should only be collected where necessary for project communication, dissemination, event participation or approved learning platform access.

For project enquiries submitted by email, the coordinating organisation may process the sender's contact details and message content in order to respond to the enquiry and manage relevant project communication.

Any learning platform registration, analytics, assessment or competence tracking data must be handled through the approved LMS environment and its applicable privacy information before public launch.

Contact for privacy enquiries: contact@pantheo.com.
